# Subodh Dahal

> Personal website and blog of Subodh Dahal

Canonical Origin: https://subodhdahal.com/

## LLM Resources

- [Full Content](https://subodhdahal.com/llms-full.txt): Complete page content in markdown format.

Keep them in one repo with full history, and set up new machines in minutes.

- [Curating my own reading and discovery feed with RSS](https://subodhdahal.com/blog/reading-and-discovery-feed-curation.md): Taking concrete steps away from algorithms using FreshRSS, self-hosted tools, and a pipeline built for me.

- [Command line and developer workflow](https://subodhdahal.com/topics/command-line.md): Git aliases, fzf, Git worktrees with Worktrunk, jq, GNU Stow dotfiles and other command-line habits that make my daily development work faster.
- [Hiking, travel and photography](https://subodhdahal.com/topics/hiking-photography.md): Trail reports from Nepal including the Tsho-Rolpa glacial lake trek, travel photos from across Europe, and tools I built for sharing photos on Instagram.
- [NixOS on the desktop](https://subodhdahal.com/topics/nixos.md): Fixes from running NixOS with COSMIC on Wayland on a ThinkPad, including a Razer Core X eGPU with an NVIDIA RTX card and Handy speech-to-text.
- [Self-hosting and homelab](https://subodhdahal.com/topics/self-hosting.md): Running my own Git forge, RSS reader and photo library at home with Forgejo, FreshRSS, Immich, Docker and Traefik, and what broke along the way.
